name: masalpark-mobil
description: MasalPark iOS/Android sarmalayıcı (Capacitor). Oyunlar üst dizindeki web kökünden www/ içine derlenir.

scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
